verdict.rationale: Consensus's own docs say every response includes citations so users can trace each insight back to the original source, which directly matches the story. The evidence is a single first-party statement plus a general transparency claim, with no hands-on verification. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of per-claim inline citation granularity (e.g., sentence-level linking to specific papers or passages), independent or hands-on corroboration that every substantive claim is actually cited.

support.subject: As a researcher, I can see citations for every substantive claim so I can verify it against the underlying source

citations.quote: Every response includes citations, so you can trace each insight back to the original source.
Search, screen, extract, and synthesize evidence faster—while keeping full transparency and scholarly rigor.
